items.title: Luther Burden caught 3-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Burden’s impact on the game was bigger than it was in the box score. He went in motion and helped block on the interior for Kyle Monangai’s first rushing touchdown. Aside from that, Burden generated a 25-yard gain on a slick post route and a 15-yard gain that helped set up Rome Odunze’s 41-yard score. Burden nearly hauled in a 46-yard pass on the Bears’ eighth drive, but Caleb Williams overthrew him. items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) was a limited participant during Thursday’s practice.
items.text: Evans was a non-participant during Wednesday’s session, and seems very likely to be a solid option even against the tough Seahawks’ defense in Week 12. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Broncos activated Tyler Badie off injured reserve.
items.text: Badie is back after missing a month with his thumb ailment. He’ll get some touches behind Jonah Coleman during Friday’s contest against the Steelers. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Rome Odunze caught 6-of-9 targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ Week 12 win over the Lions.
items.text: Caleb Williams and Odunze nearly linked up for a 20-yard touchdown during the Bears’ sixth drive, but the pass was a little too far outside the end zone for Odunze to get his feet down. Williams began looking his way more and more as the game progressed, and things really kicked off partway through the fourth quarter, when Williams hit Odunze on consecutive plays for a 15-yard gain and a 41-yard touchdown. items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) was limited during Thursday’s practice.
items.text: That makes back-to-back limited sessions for JSN. The 24-year-old seems likely to go for the pivotal Week 12 matchup against the 49ers, but fantasy managers should pay a little closer attention to Friday’s report. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Sam Darnold was listed as a full participant for Thursday’s practice.
items.text: Darnold appears to be ready to go and will likely start Sunday’s Week 12 game against the 49ers. The question is how Darnold will play, as his 2026 season has been a mixed bag, at best. Drew Lock will be ready if Darnold struggles. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Aaron Rodgers cleared waivers.
items.text: Rodgers is now officially a free agent. The quarterback could be a target of a team desperate for a quarterback who can contribute — it’s worth noting that Rodgers was not playing well prior to his blow-up —like the Patriots or the Ravens, but it’s just as feasible that this is the last time we’ve seen Rodgers on a football field. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Brock Purdy (ankle) did not participate in Thursday’s practice.
items.text: That makes back-to-back missed practices for Purdy. The 26-year-old is considered day-to-day with his ankle injury, but it’s at least a little concerning that Purdy hasn’t been able to practice this week. Fantasy managers should hope that he gets in at least a limited session Friday before the matchup against the Seahawks in Week 12. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-44 passes for 345 yards and two touchdowns in the Bears’ 39-35, Week 12 win over the Lions, adding three rushes for 15 yards.
items.text: The Bears trailed 24-35 when they got the ball back with a little over eight minutes remaining in the game. Williams then activated “Iceman” mode, linking up with Luther Burden and Rome Odunze (twice) for 71 yards, one passing touchdown and a successful QB keeper on the two-point conversion. A Lions interception and consecutive turnovers on downs for both teams resulted in the Bears getting the ball back with just over two minutes remaining in the game. items.title: Rashod Bateman (groin) was a full participant for Thursday’s practice.
items.text: Bateman got a limited practice tag Wednesday, but appears to be just fine for the Week 12 matchup against the Texans. He’s still off the fantasy radar in the majority of formats for that contest. - Christopher Crawford
